trap.label: effect/affect
trap.why: Pela semelhança de som e de afetar/efeito, o aluno troca. Affect = verbo; effect = substantivo.

opts: The warming oceans threaten the marine life in general.

fix.wrong: There is a lot of evidences.
fix.right: There is a lot of evidence.

rewrite.prompt: Passe ao plural: “The reef is damaged.”
Reescreva com negativa: “We should have waited.”
Reescreva com the fact that: “Oceans warm. This alarms us.”
rewrite.answer: The fact that oceans warm alarms us.
